# BlueCloud Infrastructure

The application is part of the GlobalFisheriesAtlas Virtual Research
Environment. Users with access can open the deployed application from the VRE:
<https://blue-cloud.d4science.org/group/globalfisheriesatlas>.

# Local R session

Restore the package environment and launch the app from the repository root:

```{r eval=FALSE}
renv::restore()
shiny::runApp()
```

DOI and fallback datasets do not require a database. Database-backed views need
the read-only connection variables documented in `docs/DOCKER_DEPLOYMENT.md`.

# Docker

The minimal application image contains the source code and a small fallback
dataset, but no full DOI dataset.

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/firms-gta/tunaatlas-app:main

docker run --rm \
  -p 3838:3838 \
  ghcr.io/firms-gta/tunaatlas-app:main
```

Open <http://localhost:3838>.

# Selected DOI dataset

The deployment architecture uses:

- `tunaatlas-app` for code and dependencies;
- `tunaatlas-data` for all rows of `DOI.csv`;
- `docker/Dockerfile.imagewithdata` to assemble one selected dataset.

The complete commands and the filename/DOI contract are maintained in
`README.md` and `docs/DOCKER_DEPLOYMENT.md`.

Every supplied dataset must follow the CWP Reference Harmonization structure
expected by the application.
